claim: Patchline ships an artifact-evaluation landing kit that assigns reviewer roles, time budgets, expected outputs, and pass/fail criteria, and anchors those instructions in regenerated public-code capstone evidence.

roles.title: Quickstart reviewer
roles.goal: Confirm a fresh user can run the capstone command, inspect the session report, and locate all expected artifacts.

roles.title: Artifact reviewer
roles.goal: Verify that generated evidence is reproducible, checksummed, deterministic, and tied to pinned public repositories.

roles.title: Security reviewer
roles.goal: Check that generated code remains quarantined, bad output is rejected, and no production credentials are required.

roles.title: Research reviewer
roles.goal: Validate that claims, limitations, figures, taxonomy, metrics, and case studies align with regenerated evidence.

pass_fail_criteria.description: Capstone summary exists and has verified true.
At least four pinned public repositories are analyzed.
The session reports more than 100 ranked data-change risks.
Every public repository has bounded generated intervention artifacts.
Plausible bad generated output is rejected by deterministic checks.
Metrics, taxonomy, claims, limitations, figures, and case studies are regenerated.
Generated session artifacts have checksum coverage.
Every reviewer role has a concrete time budget and expected review goal.
